evidence.result: 10 words from macOS say (Samantha): WER 0/10 in both runs; JSON, SRT and VTT agree on one segment 0.000-2.880 s inside 2.938 s; Metal (MTL0) reported; text identical across two processes; SRT, VTT and segments byte-identical.
evidence.scope: Generated 10-word sentence, ggml-base.en on Metal: word error, output files, bounds, rerun text. No word timing, CPU path, other models or languages. macOS arm64.

summary: C/C++ implementation of Whisper inference with a command-line transcription example. It needs a compatible model file, and timing and accuracy depend on model, language and audio.
use_when: Produce local speech transcript candidates for caption review

Need image mask extraction: Segment Anything
